display.purpose: Hero H1 and all section headlines/labels, always uppercase; never body prose.

body.purpose: Section intros, paragraphs, quotes — the only sentence-case voice on the page.

motion.name: reveal-ease
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal opacity/transform transition (0.7s) — an additive enhancement only; content is visible by default without it.

components.name: Primary CTA Pill
components.description: Full-pill link CTA, night fill — the site's own control, never a stock shadcn Button.
components.html: Chrome Web Store
components.css: .ds-cta-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.19 0.015 55); background: oklch(0.19 0.015 55); color: oklch(0.96 0.01 80); padding: 12px 24px; font-family: Unbounded, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-cta-pill:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.19 0.015 55) 85%, transparent); } .ds-cta-pill:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.7 0.2 48), 0 0 0 5px white; } .ds-cta-pill:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-cta-arrow { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

components.name: Circular CTA (light tone)
components.description: 112px circular CTA disc, night fill — used on light card backgrounds; focus ring is night (not sun) to hold AA contrast against paper.
components.css: .ds-cta-circle { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 112px; height: 112px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid oklch(0.19 0.015 55); background: oklch(0.19 0.015 55); color: oklch(0.96 0.01 80); font-family: Unbounded, sans-serif; font-size: 11.2px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-cta-circle:hover { background: oklch(0.7 0.2 48); border-color: oklch(0.7 0.2 48); color: oklch(0.16 0.02 50); } .ds-cta-circle:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.19 0.015 55); }

components.name: Platform Card
components.description: Rounded card with a blurred sun-glow accent in the corner instead of a shadow; used in the seven-platform grid.
components.html:
• NETFLIX

    Ships with seed rules
components.css: .ds-card-platform { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 16px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 18px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.02 75); background: oklch(0.99 0.01 80); padding: 36px 24px; text-align: center; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-card-platform:hover { border-color: oklch(0.6 0.19 45); } .ds-card-glow { position: absolute; top: -40px; right: -40px; width: 112px; height: 112px; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.7 0.2 48) 10%, transparent); filter: blur(24px); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Unbounded, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card-sub { font-family: Literata, serif; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.19 0.015 55 / 0.7); }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Wordmark + uppercase text links; renders as a sibling of <main> to preserve the banner landmark; ring-based focus state.

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; font-family: Unbounded, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-mark { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-nav-link { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.7 0.2 48); border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Bunny Skip's system carries NEO MIRAI's design grammar — full-bleed painted-world hero, alternating light/dark panels, one saturated single-color manifesto block, a recurring circular sun/moon disc — translated onto Bunny Skip's own subject rather than its literal Japan-specific dressing. The page's job is to demonstrate a mechanism (a rule matches, a button gets clicked, the change persists) rather than sell a mood: it refuses the icon-grid feature list in favor of a page that shows the match/click/sync loop itself, then proves seven-platform reach and a zero-network trust story in the visitor's own terms.

Warm cream paper and near-black night panels alternate section by section; the sun-orange field is spent all at once, on a single full-bleed manifesto block, so its rarity carries the page's one moment of maximum saturation. The circular disc — sun or moon depending on context — recurs as a compositional device behind marks and CTAs, never as folklore illustration.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, not neutral: every black and white carries the same warm hue family (~55–80° OKLCH), never true gray or blue-black.
One accent, spent deliberately: sun-orange is a full-section color and a CTA/focus accent, never a decorative sprinkle.
Geometric display type in all-caps against a humanist serif for body — a technical/warm contrast.
Motion and reveal are additive only: real content renders with no JS and no motion preference; scroll-reveal is a pure enhancement.

rules.name: The Warm-Only Rule
rules.body: No color in the system drops to true gray or shifts toward blue — every neutral carries the sun accent's ~55–80° hue family.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: Sun-orange fills a whole section or nothing at all — never a card fill or decorative tint.

rules.name: The All-Caps Display Rule
rules.body: Unbounded only ever appears uppercase; Literata carries every sentence-case passage.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth reads as a blurred, sun-tinted radial glow, never a directional box-shadow.

dos: Do keep every black/white/gray-adjacent value inside the warm hue family (~55–80°).
Do spend sun-orange as a whole-section field or a thin accent — nothing in between.
Do ship real content by default in CSS; motion is JS-opt-in, never CSS-default-hidden.
Do give every focus-visible state a real ring sized and colored to pass contrast against its actual background.
donts: Don't use a directional box-shadow for elevation.
Don't use a sharp or asymmetric corner anywhere.
Don't substitute a Unicode glyph for an icon.
